name: Horní Cerekev (Czechia)
description: Red field with a yellow diagonal stripe from the lower hoist to the upper fly and a white diagonal stripe from the upper hoist to the lower fly forming a saltire.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 27 April 1999 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
